source: Pinned public CUB ThreadReduce and ArgMax/ArgMin functors
adaptation: Instantiate nonempty contiguous FP32 rows with int32 keys, seed from the first element, sequentially reduce the remaining elements, and expose the key result. The seed and increasing-key specialization preserve the public first-extremum tie rule. The runtime invokes actual DeviceSegmentedReduce ArgMax/ArgMin with a key-projection output iterator.

specs.name: cub_segmented_argmax_f32
assumptions: Nonempty contiguous finite FP32 rows; disjoint int32 output; rows and cols within INT_MAX
Return the first index on equal values, relative to the start of each row; NaN behavior is outside this API equivalence
deviations: Project the key from the public key/value result
Sequential keys increase, so the smaller-key equal-value branch is unreachable; the parallel CUB functor retains it
